summary.text: Scion of Ares and co-captain beside Hippothous of the Pelasgi that rage with the spear, who dwelt in deep-soiled Larisa — sons twain of Pelasgian Lethus in the Catalogue of Ships.

story.text: Nestor's roll names Pylaeus beside Hippothous at the head of the Pelasgian tribes from Larisa, both sons of Pelasgian Lethus son of Teutamus. Homer names Pylaeus only in the muster; his brother meets his end dragging Patroclus in the battle over the body.
